1. docs/decisions/2026-08-30-server-owned-scoped-ci-runs.md:30 - The accepted ADR still states that workflow dispatch is a narrow same-repository pr_head fallback selected from verified workflow metadata and fixed server inputs. That contradicts the same ADR at lines 47-50, the public docs/spec, and the current implementation/tests, which now fail closed with dispatch_ref_unavailable and do not inspect or send a workflow-dispatch fallback. Because this ADR is accepted contract authority for the scoped CI capability, it still leaves a stale dispatch contract in durable docs. - Implementation check: apps/backend/internal/github/service_ci_run_request.go fails rerun-ineligible requests with CIRunFailureDispatchRefUnavailable and does not call dispatch. Tests cover no workflow inspection/dispatch after rerun-ineligible, persisted dispatch fallback termination, mutable-ref denial, and changed-head workflow non-inspection.
- Public docs and scoped spec now describe dispatch_ref_unavailable/no dispatch fallback behavior.
- Focused local tests passed from apps/backend: `go test ./internal/github ./internal/mcp/handlers ./internal/mcp/server ./internal/backendapp ./internal/db`.
- `git diff --check 18d38c11a09924137a492c6b3ac258090a87b17c...428f7c190fbf25786965cb4d5b5ff099546b2707` passed.
- `gh`/GraphQL was rate-limited in this session, so I could not independently refresh GitHub review threads/checks via `gh pr view`, `scripts/pr-state --summary`, or `scripts/pr-resolve list`; I relied on the coordinator-provided public provider snapshot for OPEN/DRAFT/MERGEABLE/CLEAN, 75 terminal checks, and zero failed/pending/threads.
